Heilig Schrift Fest
MDCLXXIII.
Sonnabend Den 23 Decembris, wurde die
Kirche folgender Maßen beschmückt: Der Umbgang
in der Fröygt Stube, im Altar, war von Violbraun,
und gelben goldenen Stück.
Die Kirche ward mit goldenen Drückerissen groß
würthm Tapeten besäugt, in welchen nachstehende
Historie:
Zur rechten Hand des Altars, das Abraham,
Und zur Linken des selben, die Ausfahrt Christi.
Über der Kirch Thüre, das Ecce Homo,
Davor unter dem Dschirbogen, wo der Räth
sahen, die Vorurtheilung und Hand Wäsching
Pilati, Unterdem Schuss Kirchthürlein.

Je soussigné Courtellonot Bernard Simon, vicaire à la cathédrale de Versailles, demeurant à Versailles 4 Place Saint-Louis, institue comme ma légataire universelle, Madame Veuve Courtellonot-Fridare, née Virginie Wilhelmine Leroy ma mère, sans profession, demeurant à Versailles 4 Place Saint-Louis. Fait à Versailles le vingt un octobre mil neuf cent quinze.

Bernard Simon
Courtellonot

Fort Pitt June 3. 1777

And at the time my Misfortune happened I was an
Appocater in Westmoreland County, Therefore
I hope my Situation & Proceeding will be viewed
By your Honrs in its true Light & that you would
Condescend to Indulge me with your advice
For my Government, as you are the only arbitr
At Present that Overlook the Publick affairs
of this Distracted Country

I heartely Wish you may be successfull in your
Negotiations with the friendly tribes & that
your Endavours for Peace may be to your
Mutual Satisfaction & that the good Work you
Have begun may be Settled to the true Interest
of your Country & Honrs of your worthy
Selves, is the Sincere Wish of your Most
Obed humble Servant

Diverus Smith

To the Honourable Commrs.
For Indian affairs in the Middle Department
